title: 第二章 SSS级异能！
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“系统融合中，进度百分之1”...

随着系统的融合，林夕顿时便的不省人事。

“融合程度百分之二十五”

“融合程度百分之五十”

“融合程度百分之七十五”

“融合程度百分之百”

“恭喜系统融合成功，待宿主清醒后，即刻开始系统任务。”

林夕不知道晕了多久以后，突然门外传来歇斯底里的喊叫声

林夕猛地坐了起来下意识的拿起了手边自己草草开了个刃的刀

警惕的看着宿舍门，喊叫声，救命声，以及林夕熟悉的丧尸低吼的声音

一阵阵的传来，林夕，紧张的盯着宿舍门，不久，喊声渐渐的变小

只能隐隐的听到门口传来丧尸挪动的脚步。

林夕顿时神色一松，谢了一口气缓缓的坐了下来。

林夕自言自语的说道：“还好没有人慌不择路扑向宿舍，要不然。。。。”

林夕知道宿舍的好处，当然也知道宿舍的坏处。

林夕猛然想起刚才晕倒之前好像有什么系统之类的话语。

就在林夕努力回想的时候，突然一个面板凭空出现在了他的面前。

面板上出现的内容赫然就是刚才迷迷糊糊的时候所看到的东西。

林夕惊讶又惊喜的看着这个面板，因为林夕以前也是狂热的系统小说爱好者

没想到有一天这个系统也会落到自己的头上。林夕看着物品栏里的新手大礼包。

随即点了一下，立马弹出了一个系统提示

“亲爱的林夕您好，请问您是否要使用新手大礼包？”

林夕没有由于，点了是。

冰冷的电子音再次响起：“恭喜您获得技能千里眼，顺风耳。”

“恭喜您获得初级经验丹。”

“恭喜您提前开通抽奖功能。”

“恭喜您获得初级抽奖卷一张。”

林夕听着这冰冷的声音顿时一喜随后便看向了自己的物品栏

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"System integration is in progress, progress is 1%"...

As the system merged, Lin Xi suddenly fell unconscious.

"Twenty-five percent integration level"

"Fifty percent integration"

"The degree of integration is 75%"

"One hundred percent integration"

"Congratulations on the successful system integration. Once the host wakes up, the system tasks will begin immediately."

Lin Xi didn't know how long she had been unconscious when suddenly hysterical shouting came from outside the door.

Lin Xi sat up suddenly and subconsciously picked up the knife she had hastily cut.

Watching the door of the dormitory warily, he saw shouts, cries for help, and the familiar roar of zombies that Lin Xi heard.

The shouts came one after another. Lin Xi stared nervously at the door of the dormitory. Soon, the shouts gradually became quieter.

You can only faintly hear the footsteps of zombies moving from the door.

Lin Xi's expression suddenly relaxed, and she slowly sat down with a sigh of thanks.

Lin Xi said to herself: "Fortunately, no one rushed to the dormitory in a panic, otherwise..."

Lin Xi knew the advantages of dormitories, and of course she also knew the disadvantages.

Lin Xi suddenly remembered what she had said before she fainted, as if there was some kind of system.

Just when Lin Xi was trying to remember, a panel suddenly appeared in front of him out of thin air.

The content that appeared on the panel was clearly what he had just seen in a daze.

Lin Xi looked at this panel in surprise and surprise, because Lin Xi was also an avid fan of system novels in the past.

I never thought that one day this system would fall on me.Lin Xi looked at the novice gift package in the inventory.

Then I clicked it, and a system prompt popped up immediately.

"Dear Lin Xi, would you like to use the novice gift package?"

Lin Xi had no reason to say yes.

The cold electronic sound sounded again: "Congratulations on acquiring the skill of Clairvoyance and Shunfeng Ear."

"Congratulations on your Junior Experience Dan."

"Congratulations on opening the lottery function in advance."

"Congratulations on winning a junior lottery ticket."

Lin Xi was delighted when she heard the cold voice and then looked at her inventory.
